home.title: Small gifts, carried all the way to the people they are meant for.
home.lead: We bring neighbours, volunteers and donors together, and we keep every rupee in plain sight: from the branch that collects it to the report that accounts for it.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To make local giving simple and trustworthy. Each branch is run by people from its own neighbourhood, and every figure we share can be traced back to where it came from.

programs.title: What we do
programs.intro: Three ways our branches serve their communities.

education.title: Education support
education.body: School fees, books and tutoring for children whose families cannot cover them.

health.title: Health camps
health.body: Free check-ups and basic medicines, organised with local doctors and volunteers.

relief.title: Relief drives
relief.body: Food and essentials for families in need, especially in hard seasons and emergencies.
